title: FireSmart Community Protection Guidebook
source: FireSmart Canada / Alberta Agriculture and Forestry, 2013
summary: The core community-level mitigation reference: defensible space planning, structural hardening (roofing, siding, vents, decks), vegetation management zones around homes, and a checklist-driven process for organizing a community-wide FireSmart program in the Wildland-Urban Interface.

title: Farm & Acreage Guide to Reducing Wildfire Risk
summary: Mitigation guidance tailored to rural properties: farmstead and acreage risk assessment, fuel management around outbuildings and equipment yards, livestock and machinery positioning during fire season, and rural water-source planning.

title: Alberta Wildland-Urban Interface Fires Analysis
summary: An analysis of fire behavior and outcomes specifically in Wildland-Urban Interface zones across Alberta — how geography, fuel continuity, and community layout shape hazard, with implications for where mitigation investment matters most.

title: CWFIS Data Services — Accessing Daily Maps & Data Layers
source: Canadian Wildland Fire Information System (Natural Resources Canada)
summary: Operational guide for pulling daily fire weather maps, hazard layers, and near-real-time fire information from the national CWFIS data service — the monitoring backbone that mitigation and response planning draws on.

title: Wildfire Prevention, Education & Mitigation Planning Guide
summary: A structured planning template for developing wildfire prevention programs: community risk assessment frameworks, public education campaign design, enforcement and mitigation action planning, and performance metrics for tracking prevention program effectiveness.

title: Wildfire Risk Assessment Methodology (USFS RMRS-GTR-292)
source: US Forest Service, Rocky Mountain Research Station
summary: A research-backed technical report on quantifying wildfire hazard and prioritizing mitigation investment — the methodological foundation behind how EMBER's risk scoring and feature-importance analysis is framed.
